content: High number of statement tags in comments suggests that users reply either with supporting or empathic statements or personal experience. However, 6.39% of comments contain accept and reject tags, which mark the degree to which a speaker accepts some previous proposal, plan, opinion, or statement BIBREF20. The described Dialogue Act tags are often used when commenting posters discuss original poster's point of view. For instance, “It's true. I felt the same.” – {Accept, Statement} or “Well no. You're not alone” – {Reject, Statement}. The datasets differ with respect to the distribution of these Dialogue Acts tags, they appear more frequently in OSG.
